title: Following Jesus
message: Jesus never asked for admirers — He asked for followers. "If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow Me." Following isn't a one-time decision you make and then forget; it's a daily choice to stay close to Him, the way a branch stays attached to a vine. Apart from Him you can do nothing lasting — but abiding in Him, even ordinary days start to bear real fruit.
explore: Follow, abide, learn, obey, love, serve and make disciples.
reflect: What might following Jesus change about the way you live?
pray: Jesus, teach me Your way. Help me follow You every day.
